<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ groups, I will obtain the ¹H NMR spectrum of the sample. The spectrum should list the proton signals with their chemical shifts and integration values, allowing me to identify signals that correspond to methyl groups (typically around 0.8–1.2 ppm with an integration of 3 H). By counting how many such methyl signals are present, I can provide the required integer answer.</thought>
